newsitem.title: USA: MGI PHARMA buys two products from ILEX.
newsitem.headline: MGI PHARMA buys two products from ILEX.

text.p: MGI PHARMA Inc, a specialty pharmaceutical firm, said Thursday it acquired worldwide rights to two late-stage development products from privately held ILEX Oncology Inc.
The products -- DHAC (dihydro-5-azacytidine) and oxypurinol, fit into MGI's strategy of marketing products that address unmet medical needs in oncology and rhemuatology.
DHAC is a drug that has the potential to treat several types of cancers and genetic blood diseases, MGI said. Oxypurinol is a therapy for recurrent gout.
